text:
Noah: Quick flag : I noticed one of the prepaid commit invoices for Polaris was recognized immediately instead of being deferred. Seems the usage allocation job used the wrong invoice type mapping.
Priya: Can you paste the invoice id and sample lines?
Noah: INV-2026-6120. Snippet:
```
2026-03-01 prepaid-commit polaris@example.com commit_capacity=100k tokens billed=100k tokens recognized_amount=50000.00 deferral_flag=false
2026-03-12 usage adjustment polaris@example.com usage=12k tokens applied_to_commit=true
```
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-6120 posted 2026-03-16. Tags: polaris, prepaid-commit.
Ethan: If deferral_flag should have been true, revenue is overstated by the deferred portion. What's the calculated exposure?
Noah: Using the allocation worksheet I ran: overstated recognized = 45,000.00 USD (customer still entitled to remaining service).
Priya: Ops incident shows allocation job AJ-331 failed to pick up "prepay" invoice_type due to a schema change during the March rollout. Ops ticket OP-5510 created.
Marta: Controller here : For month-end we should book an adjusting journal rather than retroactive revenue reclass to keep AR unchanged. Propose: debit 5000 (Revenue) 45,000.00; credit 2100 (Deferred Revenue) 45,000.00. Memo: "Polaris prepaid commit mis-recognition  March close accrual". Reversal in April when we post correct schedule.
Ethan: I'll prepare JE and include supporting allocation workbook and AJ-331 logs. Suggest JE id JE-2026-03-POL-03 pending approval.
Priya: I'll attach the ops link and OP-5510. Also will coordinate with billing to publish corrected revenue schedule so the April reversal aligns.
Noah: Uploaded reconciliation: https://internal.redwood/finance/recon/polaris-prepay-2026-03.xlsx (sheet: deferral_calc).
Marta: Approved. Once JE posted, include it in the close pack and flag as Controller-approved.
Noah: JE posted: JE-2026-03-POL-03 amount=45000.00 USD. Reversal scheduled 2026-04-04. Credit memos not required; we'll fix future schedule.
billing-bot: OP-5510 assigned to billing-engineering team. Priority: P2.
Priya: Closing loop  will update when schedule is corrected and reversal posts. :white_check_mark:
